observations: Three adjacent illustrative panels show a succession sequence: a person harvesting leafy crop at left; small new seedlings alongside a larger crop in middle; new crop larger while the slower crop remains at right.
No crop species label is visible; no new species identity inferred.
One-bed-over-three-seasons interpretation is supplied by canonical alt; the image depicts three panels but contains no season labels.
New sowing beside still-growing slower crop and continued occupied bed agree with source description; no image/source mismatch observed.
actualImageEvidence.limits: Viewed full actual image before the alt review; no crop timing or never-empty agronomic guarantee inferred solely from pixels.

rows.sourceEnglish: One bed over three seasons: a fast crop is harvested, then a new sowing goes in beside a slower crop that is still growing, so the bed is never empty.
rows.currentTarget: One bed over three seasons: a fast crop is harvested, then a new sowing goes in beside a slower crop that is still growing, so the bed is never empty.
rows.candidateFullTarget: Bed nthihi kha khalaṅwaha tharu: tshimela tshine tsha aluwa nga u ṱavhanya tshi a kaṋiwa; nga murahu, hu itwa zwalo ntswa tsini na tshimela tshiṅwe tshine tsha aluwa nga u ongolowa, tshine tsha kha ḓi aluwa, u itela uri bed i dzule i na zwimela tshifhinga tshoṱhe.
rows.candidateBacktranslation: One bed over three seasons: the fast-growing plant is harvested; afterward a new sowing is made beside another slower-growing plant that is still growing, so the bed always has plants.
rows.independentBacktranslation: One bed across three seasons: a quickly growing crop is harvested; afterward a new sowing is made beside another slowly growing crop still growing, so the bed is never without plants.
rows.recommendedTarget: Bed nthihi kha khalaṅwaha tharu: tshimela tshine tsha aluwa nga u ṱavhanya tshi a kaṋiwa; nga murahu, hu itwa zwalo ntswa tsini na tshimela tshiṅwe tshine tsha aluwa nga u ongolowa, tshine tsha kha ḓi aluwa, ngauralo bed a i vhuyi ya vha i si na zwimela.
rows.reason: Actual image supports the ordered three-panel succession interpretation. Prefer result connective ngauralo and explicit never-empty over candidate u itela (in order to) and always-has-plants paraphrase. Crop speed is interpreted from this harvest/growing context, not an invented days-to-maturity claim.
rows.limits: Image confirms depicted sequence and beside/still-growing relations; it does not independently prove duration of three seasons or a universal never-empty rule, which remain exact canonical narrative.
